title: Delivery Transformation Director
description:
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Delivery Transformation Director to drive the successful execution and growth of large-scale transformation programs. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with a proven track record of delivering complex, large-scale projects at top-tier consulting firms. This is a unique opportunity to own the end-to-end delivery of our most strategic client engagements whilst shaping and expanding our solution and delivery capabilities.

Job responsibilities

  • Delivery Leadership: Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of complex transformation programs. Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards, exceeding client expectations.
  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with C-level executives and key client stakeholders. Serve as the primary point of contact for all program-related matters and proactively manage risks and issues.
  • Team Leadership and Program Management: Provide mentorship and guidance to project teams, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability. Oversee resource allocation, project timelines, and budget management across multiple engagements.
  • Growth and Business Development: Identify and pursue opportunities for program expansion and new business within existing accounts. Partner with the sales and solution teams to contribute to proposals, statements of work, and go-to-market strategies.

title: Senior Product Manager (w/m/d)
description:
Who We Are

Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at verve.com.

Who You Are

We are currently seeking a Senior Product Manager to own our Identity Graph / Enrichment & Audience Enhancement products. You will lead an already established Identity & Audience team to grow Verve's presence in the AdTech space through the innovative execution of key strategic initiatives. The successful candidate will participate in the development of the product strategy and product roadmaps, leading product initiatives end-to-end from ideation to launch and go-to-market. They will inform product requirements, collaborate with engineering on implementation, take products to market through extensive A/B testing & experimentation, and be responsible for commercial success.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

 

 

About the Role

As a Senior DevOps Engineer at Ledgy, you'll build the infrastructure and tooling that help our engineers ship quickly and reliably. You'll join our Platform team, collaborating with engineers and InfoSec to improve CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure for a product that helps companies manage equity.

Our challenge is to make delivery faster, production easier to operate, and AI-assisted development safer - while keeping complexity and costs in check.

Location: We hire remotely across Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania.

title: Senior Mechatronic System Architect | Medical Robotics (m/f/d)
description:
Senior Mechatronic System Architect | Medical Robotics (m/f/d)

Location: Maastricht, Aachen, and Eindhoven region, working mainly on-site with our development partner in Maastricht. Regular travel to Hamburg and to clinical sites, about 2 to 4 days per month.

Reports to: CTO

About the venture: ROB'E

ROB'E is a Hamburg-based medtech startup and part of the NLC Health Ventures portfolio. We are developing a robotic system that holds and steers a standard transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) probe during structural heart interventions. Interventionalists get stable, reproducible echo views, and echocardiographers no longer have to stand next to the patient in the X-ray field.

Our first-generation prototype has been used in a first-in-human study with published results. We are now developing the next generation from scratch as a fully compliant medical device for CE marking and FDA clearance. The team includes a CTO, a System Software Architect and a Head of Quality & Regulatory.

The role

You are the mechatronic design authority of ROB'E. You own the system architecture, the hardware requirements and the technical decisions for the mechanics, drives, sensing and electronics of our robot. You work on site with our engineering development partner in the Maastricht area and steer their team on our behalf. This is a hands-on senior role: you design yourself, review the work of others and make sure the hardware is safe, verifiable and ready for design transfer.

Responsibilities

  • Define and own the mechatronic system architecture: robotic device, drives, force and torque sensing, real-time controllers, safety supervisor, power supply and the interface to commercial TEE probes.
